$comment: The leaves' look (docs/WORK_QUEUE.md item 5, the Leaf Lab's option 5 at its defaults; owner, 2026-11-11: "#5 looks really good with defaults"; docs/TREE_GROWTH.md §10). blocks: the blocks drawn this way, by name (leaves stay blocks; nothing on the wire). canopyBlend: how far (0 none, 1 all) a leaf face's lighting normal leans from its face toward the crown's outward direction, away from the centroid of the leaf cells within 3 m of the point (the same reach each way, so neighbouring chunks agree), so a crown shades as one rounded mass (the Lab fitted an ellipsoid to each tree; the mesher has no tree record). chamfer: how far (cells; a cell is 1 m across and ½ m tall, so 0.28 m across and 0.14 m up) a leaf cell's edges and corners are cut back where both faces meeting there are exposed (no leaf beside them); cells inside the crown stay full cubes, and the face between two leaf cells is filled where one is cut back and the other not, so a chamfer's end shows no gap. cards (the Lab's leaf cards; owner: "Cards could only show on near trees"): painted leaf clumps, alpha-cut quads standing off exposed leaf faces, facing out of the crown: density (cards per exposed face, scaled per face: tops 2.6×, sides 2.2× by their area, bottoms 1.2×), sizeM (a card's width, ±25 %), swayM (how far the wind moves a card's corners), and fadeStartM to fadeEndM, over which they dissolve with distance (24–40 m since 0.54.x, was 48–64: BUGS.md #78, the M1 at High; the vertex shader drops a card past fadeEndM so it costs no pixels); interiorCells: a face's cards are dropped when another leaf cell lies within that many cells straight out of it (the face looks into a cavity inside the crown; 0 keeps all); backCullM: the vertex shader drops a card whose plane the eye is more than that many metres behind (the crown's far side, facing away; 0 never); tile: the atlas tile they are painted with (shared/textures/materials.json `tiles`, the painted leaf clump); tiers: whether each renderer tier meshes them (`dwell-client` `render::cards_for`; a `?cards=0|1` dev override wins): desktop (a GPU on a desktop page), phone (a touch device's page: off, owner 2026-11-11, "~23 fps on mobile", docs/BUGS.md: their alpha-cut overdraw is per pixel on a phone's tile GPU) and cpu (a CPU adapter, the cheapest tier of everything: off). A card is never placed where any of its corners reaches into a neighbouring block that is neither leaves nor empty (a trunk's bark: it z-fought). Run `node shared/look/leaves.mjs` after editing; CI fails if crates/dwell-look/src/leaves.gen.rs is stale.
